title: CAS Test Plan Manifest
description: Inventory of test specification files, their coverage targets, and implementation status. Follows the pattern of docs/fs/manifest.json.

tiers.1: Contract tests: schema validation and API contract shape verification, mechanically derived from the formal substrate.
tiers.2: Behavioral tests: semantic rules, error paths, lifecycle logic, policy enforcement. Requires design decisions.
tiers.3: Domain integration tests: end-to-end validation with PIM Health configs and representative workflows.

test_specs.title: Cross-Cutting Boundary Tests
test_specs.notes: 6 fully specified from SAGE decisions, 3 stubs awaiting ROOT Harness tier 2 decisions, 3 error semantics stubs

revision_history.summary: Initial manifest. Four test spec files covering tiers 1-3. Scaffolding: pyproject.toml, conftest.py, SchemaValidator helper.

SAGE tier 2 behavioral test specifications. 42 tests across 7 subsystems encoding 19 design decisions (document ID generation, concurrency model, lifecycle error semantics, ingestion duplicate detection, pipeline failure quarantine, retrieval fusion, graph deduplication, path security, retrieval health assertions). Cross-cutting boundary tests expanded from stub to 12 tests (6 specified, 6 stubs awaiting ROOT Harness decisions). Schema changes identified for formal substrate update.
